index.html.Pour découvrir l'échiquier et les pièces: Discover the board and the pieces while doing some maths, finding your way around and enjoying a bit of luck. Play alone, with your family or in class.

index.html.Regarde le dernier coup joué et écris-le: Look at the last move played and write it on the score sheet, like a real player.
index.html.Choisis un champion, regarde une de ses: Pick a champion, watch one of their great games, and play their best moves for them.
index.html.Pose des pièces de chaque côté et trouve: Put pieces on each side and find the balance.
